message.content: {"decision":"REVISE","issues":[{"issue_id":"polarity_template_labels_inverted","severity":"blocker","description":"Template polarity labels conflict with a coherent antiparallel fork. template_leading is labeled 3'→5' (start left 3', end right 5') and template_lagging 5'→3'. With the helicase junction at the right and the opened region to the left, leading synthesis that proceeds 5'→3' toward the fork requires the leading template to be read 3'→5' left-to-right, i.e., its end near the fork should be 3', not 5'. As drawn, new_leading grows rightward (its 3' end at 'end'), but the adjacent template end is labeled 5', so the label pair is inverted. The lagging template's right-side 3' and its fragments growing leftward are consistent; only the leading/template pair is wrong.","root_cause_stage":"SCENE_IR","target_objects":["template_leading","template_lagging","new_leading"],"target_events":["event_1_fork","event_3_extension"],"repair_scope":"Fix endpoint_labels in SCENE_IR only: set template_leading start=5', end=3' on the drawn path (or relabel the synthesis direction), keeping template_lagging 5'→3' left-to-right. Do not change geometry, animations, or approved materials.","acceptance_criteria":["template_leading readable 3'→5' by polymerase traveling toward the junction; new_leading grows 5'→3' with its 3' end adjacent to the template 3' end region","template_lagging remains 5'→3' left-to-right with fragments growing toward the left","No reverse of fragment_1/fragment_2 growth directions","Re-run deterministic polarity checks and section-4 review"]},{"issue_id":"ligase_label_mechanism_ambiguity","severity":"minor","description":"Maturation caption says 'Remove RNA, fill DNA, then seal a nick' and ligase seals the gap_fill/fragment_1 nick, but the RNA-primer removal step has no explicit enzyme/step shown and Pol δ is reused for gap fill after being hidden. This is within declared simplification scope (RNaseH/FEN1 omitted) but the caption should not imply the shown Pol δ performs primer removal.","root_cause_stage":"SCENE_IR","target_objects":["polymerase_lagging","ligase","rna_primer_lagging_1","gap_fill"],"target_events":["event_5_maturation"],"repair_scope":"Caption/label only; keep omission of RNaseH/FEN1 as allowed simplification, but clarify RNA removal is an unshown prerequisite step and that Pol δ fills the gap.","acceptance_criteria":["Caption does not attribute RNA primer removal to Pol δ or ligase","Declared simplification for RNaseH/FEN1 remains explicit","Ligase still seals only the gap_fill/fragment_1 nick at coincident endpoints"]},{"issue_id":"final_caption_scope_unverified","severity":"uncertain","description":"event_5 caption 'Remove RNA, fill DNA, then seal a nick' and overall title are fine under the declared one-local-fork scope, but no final caption text is provided to confirm it does not claim the whole genome/replication is complete while other primers remain visible. This ambiguity affects teaching mechanism integrity and cannot be auto-passed.","root_cause_stage":"ASSEMBLY","target_objects":["rna_primer_lagging_2","rna_primer_leading"],"target_events":["event_5_maturation"],"repair_scope":"Provide/verify final caption and on-screen labels against the declared simplification 'final caption must not claim all replication completed'.","acceptance_criteria":["Final caption states only one local maturation shown","No claim of genome-wide or fork-wide completion","Other primers remain visible and unmodified"]}],"notes":["Positive: exactly two parental strands, antiparallel pairing rungs, junction helicase placement, leading continuous rightward growth, lagging fragments leftward growth, primer-before-extension preconditions, and coincident gap_fill/fragment_1 nick endpoints are all consistent with the teaching model.","Polarity rule_id: DNA_STRAND_POLARITY. Leading template must be 3' toward the fork so Pol ε (new 5'→3') reads it 3'→5' toward the junction; current template_leading endpoint labels invert this.","Allowed simplifications honored: schematic geometry, Pol ε leading model hedge, one local maturation, no telomerase/chromosome-end claim. Do not demand RNaseH/FEN1 or licensing here."]}
